::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes\
**Cook time:** 45 minutes

[Side]{.badge .badge-side} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*Throwback to the OG Shug.*

## Ingredients

- 1 cup chopped onion
- 1 cup chopped celery
- 1 stick butter (melted)
- 2–3 packages baked cornbread
- 1 can baked biscuits
- 1 container chicken broth
- 1 can cream of celery, mushroom, or chicken soup

## Instructions

*Preheat oven to 375°F.*

1. Mix cornbread, biscuits, onion, celery, and butter together.
2. Add chicken broth and soup to get the consistency you want.
3. Bake until golden brown on top (use the broiler if desired).
